title: do-you-have-a-crush-on.me: glowing pixel title, hearts as the picture frame
note: A fan site for your own listening. The title is a black bar with rounded corners and a thin red keyline, holding a blackletter pixel face lit hot pink-red with layered text-shadows so it glows like a sign: these are my spotify crushes of the last 6 months. Below, a pink-to-grey glossy tray holds five artists, each photo cropped into a heart and sat in a black card with a red blur halo, name above in small pixel type. Background is a pale grey wallpaper of hand-drawn outline doodles with green pills. A genre line runs across as text. Worth reusing: a heart clip-path turns any photo into a crush; a title that says exactly what the page is (these are my…) in a glowing bar. Built into the glow-title and heart-picks blocks.
